finding.headline: The 3 cohorts recommended in the earlier body review (GEO-Core, GEO-Placement-Recovery, Interface-Domain) were grouped by SUBJECT MATTER, not by link topology. The actual sibling-link graph shows they are NOT separable: 19 of 36 total sibling edges cross between these 3 groups.
finding.implication: Publishing GEO-Core, GEO-Placement-Recovery, and Interface-Domain as 3 separate bounded publications -- as originally planned -- would recreate the exact partial-cluster bug that already happened once this session (i-lan-geo-bypass-1.md referencing un-moved siblings). connected_component.rule_applied: Rule option 1 -- move the complete coherent component atomically.
